readArtifacts: stardust/current/_style-capture/*.json (supplementary live Playwright pass for computed typography, logo, favicon, radius/shadow, palette samples — crawl.mjs's reference capture() does not read computed style)
notes: Font family names (BaloiseBold, BaloiseText, BaloiseMedium) are read verbatim from computed getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily and @font-face rules on the live site — not chosen by the agent. They reflect the merged Helvetia/Baloise identity referenced in the site's own banner copy ('Helvetia und Baloise sind jetzt eins').

index.json (helvetia.com root, redirected to helvetia-baloise.com) captured a blocking country/language-selector modal, not the corporate homepage content. Excluded from cross-page aggregation as unreliable; kept in current/pages/ for audit trail only. See _crawl-log.json#visionCheck.

Cookie-consent banner remained visibly rendered in 2/5 screenshots (geschaeftskunden, ueber-uns) — consent dismissal is per-browser-context and this crawl ran concurrency=4. The banner's own text is still correctly excluded from headings/body/ctas by the INTERSTITIAL filter (see per-page _signals.filteredInterstitials), so this is a screenshot-only artifact, not a data-quality issue.

A product-finder/calculator widget renders as an empty mint-green placeholder box on privatkunden, geschaeftskunden and personnes-privees screenshots — a client-side widget whose content did not resolve within the capture wait window. Its visual footprint (rounded card, mint background) is real; its content is opaque to this extraction.

Palette hex values for the accent family are read from the site's own CSS custom-property design-token sheet (558 --helvetia-* tokens) cross-checked against sampled computed backgroundColor/color across all 5 pages; both sources agree.

palette.note: Dual role: this is both the dominant text color site-wide (near-black-navy body copy) AND the brand primary used for buttons, the contact band section, and the footer background.

Present in the site's own design-token sheet (semantic 'danger/promo' light background) but not sampled with visible area on the 5 crawled pages; included for completeness, not from direct pixel evidence.

scaleAudit.note: h1/h2 both render at 38px/700 (no distinct h1 step observed on the crawled pages); h2→h3 is 1.583x, h3→body is 1.5x (exactly perfect-fifth) but the pair isn't consistent across the whole scale, so this reads as ad-hoc rather than a single modular ratio.

type.loadStrategy: unknown (fonts are embedded as base64 data: URIs inside @font-face rules rather than served as network files; no font-display value inspected)

spacing.note: Scale read directly from the --helvetia-space-* token ladder (0.25rem steps to 1rem, then a second desktop-responsive ladder to 8rem). sectionPadding/gridGap not captured — the crawler does not read per-section computed padding/gap; only tokens and sampled element styles were available this pass.
